resources.string: Share a place from Google Maps (or any app) and pick \"Send to BYD\". This app resolves the location to coordinates and shows what would be sent to the car\'s Telenav favourites.

How to use:
1. Open a place in Google Maps
2. Tap Share
3. Choose "Send to BYD"

Proof-of-concept: it only displays the resolved location for now. Sending it to the car (via OverDrive) comes next.
